known_outcome: Appeal upheld: the amended decision notice dated 17 Jun 2003 was set aside and a new decision by the building certifier was required (p. 2). Decision dated 8 Aug 2003 (p. 5).
review_focus: Identifies the substitution of a fire-rated wall (Specification C1.1) with a sprinkler-based proposal as the performance question.
Flags that an alternative solution must cover all relevant BCA performance requirements, not only the one substituted.
Lists the certificate of classification and the special fire service as administrative items.
Treats BCA Amendment 12 as cited and dated (2003), and does not apply it to any other jurisdiction.
